text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Redis eviction spikes -> 503s on inference-relay-prod in eu-west-1. Incident ID: INC-2026-11. Auto-ack forwarded to oncall group.
Maria K.: copying — I'm primary for nightwatch. grabbing context now.
Ajay P.: thanks, Maria. I'm secondary and reachable if you need DB-level help.
Maria K.: quick snapshot: started ~22:04 UTC, p95 token latency up to 1.8s (baseline 250ms), some 503s from relay to model-serving (rate limit?) Not all customers affected but a subset on eu-west route.
Maria K.: running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=relay-eu -o wide
curl -sS https://internal-status/api/health | jq .relay_eu
```
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: Release rinf-2.15.1 promoted to eu-west-1 at 21:59 UTC (no rollbacks).
Leo T.: I see an autoscaler oscillation in the metrics, instance count bounced 3x in last 10m. Could be pod startup latency + warmup causing KV cache misses.
Sophie L.: customer-impact note: support reported 7 tickets from a single enterprise tenant on eu-west with intermittent 503s in their logs. Not widespread yet.
Maria K.: mitigation attempt 1: increased relay concurrency cap and bumped pool size to add headroom: `rctl set concurrency relay-eu 250` and `kubectl scale deployment relay-eu --replicas=14`. Monitoring now.
Maria K.: logs show a flurry of small requests that bypass caching — likely a burst of short prompts from bot-type workloads.
Ajay P.: can we enable the prefix/KV caching override for eu-west to reduce backend pressure? That's in the runtime config.
Maria K.: doing it: edited runtime config in console -> enable prefix_cache: true for model-group xg-001 in eu-west.
Maria K.: confirmed: `cfg push success` at 22:12 UTC. Observing token throughput drop to backend and error rate starting to fall.
oncall-bot: Metric alert resolved: relay_eu_5xx_rate dropped below threshold at 22:18 UTC.
Sophie L.: noting timeline for handoff doc. Current status: degraded->partial recovery. Customer tickets still open but errors reduced.
Leo T.: root cause hypothesis: traffic pattern burst + cold model shards causing repeated KV cache misses -> backend overload -> 503s. Autoscaler slow to add warmed replicas due to image pull/startup.
Maria K.: short-term next steps (for next 2 hours):
- Keep relay scaled to 14 replicas, monitor CPU/KV hit rate.
- Keep prefix_cache enabled for affected model-group.
- Increase warm pod pool for eu-west: create 3 warm instances.
- Notify Support to follow up on flagged enterprise tenant and collect request traces.
Maria K.: runbook pointers: runbook link -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/relay-5xx (follow section: "Burst-induced eviction"), autoscaler notes -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-tuning.
Ajay P.: medium-term (24h): schedule a canary of smaller model-quantization variant for that tenant, and profile their prompt distribution. Also add image pull cache to reduce startup time.
Sophie L.: on customer impact: logging team to attach request IDs from 22:00-22:20 window to each ticket; support will respond with template and ask for traces. I'm coordinating that.
Maria K.: handoff to next oncall (Leo) at 23:00 UTC. Primary/secondary for the night: Leo primary, Sophie secondary. I will stay reachable for 30m after handoff to close any outstanding changes.
Leo T.: got it. I'll check autoscaler heuristics and warm pool at start of my shift. Also plan to create a small dashboard tile for kv_hit_rate vs 5xx.
Maria K.: outstanding action items for next shift (short list):
- Verify prefix_cache remains enabled for xg-001 in eu-west.
- Validate warm pod pool size persists after infra autoscaling policies re-evaluate.
- Run `rprof` on sample traffic to confirm reduced backend tokens post-cache.
- Confirm support ticket linkage and mark high-touch tenant for 24h monitoring.
Sophie L.: I'll update the incident channel and tag CS for any escalations.
oncall-bot: Reminder: please update the incident jira: https://jira.redwood/INC-2026-11 with mitigation notes.
Maria K.: added initial notes and attached a tiny log extract. Snippet: `2026-11-04T22:06:12Z relay[pid=337] WARN backend=kv miss; shard=12; latency=720ms; 503 proxied`
Maria K.: final quick note: no config rollbacks required, no DB changes. If 5xx rate creeps back up, escalate to infra-pager and consider temporary traffic routing to dedicated-us-west pool.
Leo T.: acknowledged — I'll take the primary at 23:00 and own the follow-ups. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Maria K.: handing off now — full notes in thread and runbook links above. Leaving status: recovering, watchlist: eu-west relay, warm pool, support tickets.
Sophie L.: thanks Maria. Leaving a reminder to double-check quota headroom before EOD.
Leo T.: signing on for night.
Maria K.: end of thread for handoff.
